        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug.

        From e6984f84d53115810e7936b8ee240b3a67789e56 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Michael Meffie <mmeffie@sinenomine.net>
Date: Fri, 28 Mar 2014 17:08:46 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] volser: fix spurious strcat of volume extension.

Fix malformed merge error left over from
commit 4f9ec8396d1c7f12f8fa264cea7c255ce62b7b8d
where we converted strcat to strlcat.

Reviewed-on: http://gerrit.openafs.org/10963
Reviewed-by: Jeffrey Altman <jaltman@your-file-system.com>
Tested-by: BuildBot <buildbot@rampaginggeek.com>
(cherry picked from commit e6110959e802bd9ae60e3724ba41078e7b335bab)

Change-Id: I3ac39245f9151f319ab5d5bb6b6d17dd13446ac1

Reviewed-by: Chas Williams - CONTRACTOR <chas@cmf.nrl.navy.mil>
Reviewed-by: Andrew Deason <adeason@sinenomine.net>
Tested-by: BuildBot <buildbot@rampaginggeek.com>
Reviewed-by: Stephan Wiesand <stephan.wiesand@desy.de>
---
 src/volser/vsprocs.c | 5 -----
 1 file changed, 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/volser/vsprocs.c b/src/volser/vsprocs.c
index 8673850a8..b4b17e906 100644
--- a/src/volser/vsprocs.c
+++ b/src/volser/vsprocs.c
@@ -3084,11 +3084,6 @@ GetTrans(struct nvldbentry *vldbEntryPtr, afs_int32 index,
 	    goto fail;
 	}
 
-	if (tmpVolId)
-	    strcat(volname, ".roclone");
-	else
-	    strcat(volname, ".readonly");
-
 	if (verbose) {
 	    fprintf(STDOUT,
 		    "Creating new volume %lu on replication site %s: ",
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect use of `strcat` instead of `strlcat` when appending volume extensions to the `volname` string. This led to potential buffer overflows and malformed strings, as `strcat` does not check for buffer size, which could result in writing beyond the allocated memory for `volname`. The patch removed the erroneous `strcat` calls to prevent these issues.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>

    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect use of `strcat` instead of `strlcat` when appending volume extensions to the `volname` string. This led to potential buffer overflows and malformed strings, as `strcat` does not check for buffer size, which could result in writing beyond the allocated memory for `volname`. The patch removed the erroneous `strcat` calls to prevent these issues.
